symptom: Forward Evaluation Vault RESULT.metrics used additionalProperties type:number without finite bounds. In synthetic Python jsonschema Draft 2020-12, positive and negative Infinity produced by JSON exponent overflow were admitted by that rule while validateForwardVaultRecord rejects non-finite metric values. This is a schema-only metadata contract gap, not observed real evidence corruption or production behavior.
lesson: JSON Schema type:number does not guarantee finite numeric values when a JSON exponent overflows into Infinity. Runtime finite-metric validation must remain authoritative; schema-only consumers need explicit representable-number bounds.
guardrail: For research-only Forward Vault RESULT.metrics, retain minimum:-Number.MAX_VALUE and maximum:Number.MAX_VALUE in the numeric additionalProperties schema, with both-sign overflow and finite-boundary regression tests. JSON Schema cannot distinguish negative zero from zero; keep the runtime signed-zero digest guardrail. Never infer authentic outcomes, scoring readiness or production authority from schema acceptance.
